doc: Loaded under every specialty pack. A pack's own three lists ALWAYS win over these; that override is load-bearing, not decorative (physiotherapy claims gym/massage, dermatology claims beauty salon/spa, ophthalmology claims optician, ENT claims hearing aid store, cardiology and orthopaedics claim diagnostic imaging).

matching.never_substring: Category matching is set membership on the normalized string. Substring matching makes 'clinic' match 'dental clinic' and silently drags the wrong market in.
matching.name_token_rule: Tokens of 3 chars or fewer must match with BOTH word boundaries; longer tokens match as left-anchored prefixes so 'dermat' covers dermatology/dermatologist. Without the right boundary on short tokens, 'ent' matches 'Enterprises'.
precedence: The category sets the ANCHOR; a name token moves it at most ONE step. Name evidence is softer than Google's category, so it may never flip relevant to irrelevant or irrelevant to relevant in a single hop.
anchor: pack.relevant -> pack.irrelevant -> pack.adjacent -> base.universally_irrelevant -> base.generic_medical_adjacent -> unknown (first match wins)

1. anchor relevant    -> veto (with NO name_strong) lowers ONE step to adjacent; otherwise relevant. A name carrying both a strong and a veto token is contradictory, so it counts as no signal and the category anchor stands.
2. anchor irrelevant  -> name_strong (with no veto) lifts ONE step to adjacent; otherwise irrelevant
3. anchor adjacent    -> veto lowers to irrelevant; name_strong lifts to relevant; otherwise adjacent
4. anchor base.universally_irrelevant -> irrelevant, HARD, no name movement. This is the one asymmetric rule: the anchor is non-medical, so a restaurant called 'Skin Bar' must not become a clinic.
6. anchor unknown -> veto -> irrelevant; name_strong -> relevant; otherwise adjacent, and emit to the category_unlisted curation log
matching.precedence_evidence: Replaying the 97 real Guntur records: 'AIRA IMAGING & DIAGNOSTIC CENTER LLP' carries the category 'Dermatologist'. A veto-cannot-override rule kept it relevant and poisoned the peer set; a veto-wins rule dropped a genuine skin clinic whose name mentions another service. The one-step cap lands it in adjacent: fully extracted, never benchmarked as a peer.

tiers.lite_note: The results-feed card carries the category at div.W4Efsd > div.W4Efsd > span > span (verified against the saved 97-card Guntur feed), so the tier is decided BEFORE navigation at zero cost. The card carries no phone, so a lite extract still costs one page open.

rules: Query 1 is always the seed and is never skipped.
The city name must be IN the query text (measured 2026-08-18: Google ignores uule).
No 'near me' phrasings: they resolve against the crawler's IP, not the target city.
